reviews.summary: A major Binance hot-wallet breach on October 29 remains a relevant market-structure and counterparty-risk overhang for BTC: Binance reported 18,270 BTC stolen and was still acquiring less-liquid assets to complete restoration. No BTC unlock risk was identified.
materialRisks: Large exchange security incident: Binance disclosed unauthorized hot-wallet transfers, including 18,270 BTC, on October 29, 2026; the scale and ongoing recovery process can elevate BTC liquidity and headline-driven volatility risk. ([binance.com](https://www.binance.com/en/square/post/384336744180903))

facts.fact: Binance says it reserved more than 100% of funds needed for losses; as of October 31, 2026, 98% of affected token assets had been restored, while it was acquiring remaining less-liquid assets. ([binance.com](https://www.binance.com/en/square/post/384336744180903))

Binance states no further unauthorized transfers were observed after the final confirmed transfer at 23:56 UTC on October 29, 2026. ([binance.com](https://www.binance.com/en/square/post/384336744180903))
BTC has no scheduled token unlocks as of November 13, 2026. ([defillama.com](https://defillama.com/unlocks/bitcoin))

No execution venue was supplied. Kraken’s public status page shows prior BTC Lightning funding maintenance completed on November 3, rather than an active BTC spot-trading incident. ([status.kraken.com](https://status.kraken.com/))
